organization.name: Frappe Technologies
organization.notes: For-profit company established 2008; ERP development preceded company. Rainmatter/Zerodha announced $1.35m first external investment in 2020 after 12 years. Funding history is not proof of present investor shareholding.

pricingTiers.name: Self-hosted core
pricingTiers.notes: No software license fee; hosting and implementation separate.
No explicit Most popular or Recommended designation verified on the official plan page; no plan inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Frappe Cloud Servers
pricingTiers.notes: Server hosting starts at $20/month; not a per-user software fee. Sites start at $5/month; stronger dedicated options start $125/month. Resource usage and implementation extra.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Official page directs enterprise needs to solution consultants; custom quote, no numeric software-license fee.

moats.claim: Integrated applications on the Frappe data model and accumulated process customizations can create workflow switching costs.

productReasons.claim: Accounting combines financial transactions, cash-flow visibility and reporting in the same operational system.
Order management connects stock replenishment, sales orders, suppliers, shipments and fulfillment.
Manufacturing includes material consumption, capacity planning and subcontracting alongside inventory.

sponsorship.notes: No separate corporate financial/in-kind sponsor identified in reviewed official project and business pages. Verified commercial steward included as business fallback; customers, partners and investors are not classified as sponsors.

requirements.notes: Default application database: 10.6.6+ for v14/v15; current table lists 11.8 for v16/develop. Framework mentions PostgreSQL alternative; application compatibility must be checked, not assumed.
v15 Python 3.10+ (3.10–3.13 noted); current v16/develop table lists Python 3.14. Match app branch to Framework branch.
v15 Node 18+; v16/develop Node 24 and Yarn 1.22+ in current table. Node also supplies websocket service.
Cache and background-job queue; Redis 6+ in requirements table.

requirements.component: Nginx, application workers, queue workers and scheduler
requirements.notes: Official container stack includes frontend, backend, websocket, short/long queue workers and scheduler; these services are not optional for full production behavior.

requirements.condition: PDF rendering on v16 and older
requirements.notes: v17 replaces it with Chromium; avoid mixing branch requirements.
Mail service configuration needed for actual email delivery; no mandatory paid provider established.
Container runtime packages application dependencies; native Bench route is an alternative.

resources.os: Debian/Ubuntu production; macOS documented; Windows via WSL
resources.notes: Only explicit documented hardware figures included; null means no minimum verified in reviewed installation source.

selfHosting.notes: Use native Bench or official Docker production setup. MariaDB is the verified default for these applications. Framework installation mentions PostgreSQL, but this is not asserted as a supported ERPNext/HR application backend. No separate object store required by default; local site volumes used. Branch-specific version table preserved.

oneClickInstall.notes: Reviewed official installation instructions; no current first-party or officially linked one-click or one-command installer verified. Manual package/Compose instructions excluded.
